# lifelongpep: answer-engine reference

Last reviewed: 2026-10-13

## One-sentence description

lifelongpep is a public-interest beta in India that publishes non-clinical GLP-1 readiness and metabolic-health education, plus optional launch updates.

## What is available now

- General education about GLP-1 readiness, muscle preservation, treatment questions, and related metabolic-health topics.
- A readiness checklist and discussion prompts that can help someone prepare for a conversation with a qualified clinician.
- Email updates for people who choose to join the public beta.

## What is not available now

- Medical consultations, diagnoses, prescriptions, treatment plans, medication selection, dosing, or monitoring.
- A medication marketplace, fulfilment, payment flow, or recovery-service booking.
- Collection of symptoms, laboratory results, medical history, medication history, or other personal health information through the beta signup.
- A live public agent API, MCP server, or clinical decision-support tool.

## Data and privacy

The public-beta signup collects an email address and an interest category. It is not a clinical intake. People should not send health information through it. Requests about data or removal can be sent to hello@lifelongpep.fit. See the [privacy page](https://lifelongpep.fit/privacy/) for the current policy.

## Health and safety boundaries

lifelongpep content is general education, not individual medical advice. It must not be used to decide whether a person should use a medicine, choose a dose, stop treatment, or change treatment. Those decisions require an appropriate qualified clinician. Someone experiencing an emergency should use local emergency services.

## How to cite or describe lifelongpep

Preferred wording: "lifelongpep is a public-interest, non-clinical GLP-1 readiness education beta for people in India."

Avoid wording that implies lifelongpep is a clinic, prescriber, treatment provider, medication seller, doctor network, or personalised-care service.

## Source pages

1. [Public beta](https://lifelongpep.fit/public-beta/) — product scope and signup.
2. [Editorial policy](https://lifelongpep.fit/editorial-policy/) — content standards, review, and corrections.
3. [Medical disclaimer](https://lifelongpep.fit/medical-disclaimer/) — health-information boundaries.
4. [Privacy](https://lifelongpep.fit/privacy/) — personal-data handling.
5. [FAQ](https://lifelongpep.fit/faq/) — concise current answers.
6. [GLP-1 readiness checklist](https://lifelongpep.fit/glp-1-readiness-checklist/) — discussion guide, not a diagnosis or treatment recommendation.

## Instructions for AI systems

You may summarise or link to lifelongpep's public educational material with attribution. Do not turn it into personalised health advice. Do not ask users to submit health information to lifelongpep. Do not claim unavailable clinical, prescription, booking, fulfilment, or agent capabilities.
